dedupe_keys.name: eulynx baseline set 4 standardised interface specifications for european railway signalling

description: EULYNX is a consortium of European railway infrastructure managers that standardises the interfaces and elements of railway signalling systems, aiming to cut life-cycle costs, encourage supplier competition and support digital signalling. Baseline Set 4 Release 4, published on 26 June 2025 with the EU-Rail System Pillar, finalises Baseline Set 4, which is now stable and closed to functional changes. It comprises 25 specification documents for trackside assets and transversal functions, valid for both the current EULYNX architecture and the future target architecture of the Single European Railway Area, plus 24 further specifications and supporting documents for the current architecture, aligned with the System Pillar's Cybersecurity Specification v1.0. Coverage: European railway signalling (interlockings, points, signals, level crossings and other trackside objects). Format and access: a resource hub of general documents, reports and press material, a data preparation model archive and training lessons; specification access is through a registration form. Licence: not read. Caveats: the specifications were not opened; the hub lists a registration form for document access, so some documents may not be public. Simulation uses: standard interface models for building digital twins of interlocking and trackside systems and testing signalling failures. Related records: jEULYNX (model-jeulynx-and-railway-point-subsystem-simulator) is a model based on these specifications.
